items.title: "C'est le docteur Guérit-tout": Serge Veilleux's 1981 TV performance
items.summary: An archival Quebec TV clip shows Serge Veilleux, a pint-sized 16-year-old who had received a kidney transplant four years earlier, belting the traditional Quebec folk song "Le docteur Guérit-tout" ("C'est le docteur Guérit-tout, qui a un remède à tout"), a comic call-and-response tune about a doctor who cures every ailment by cutting off another body part. The clip resurfaced and took over X on the evening of Oct 11, 2026. It had a first viral run on TikTok in late 2024, tied to the folklore show Soirée canadienne, when many viewers mistook the boy for actor Antoine Bertrand.
